title.zh: Bitget Raises Hack Estimate To $387.5 Million As Token Accounting Widens
title.en: Bitget Raises Hack Estimate To $387.5 Million As Token Accounting Widens

current_state.zh: Bitget has raised its estimated hack losses to $387.5 million, with XRP and ether dominating identified outflows, as withdrawals stay paused and Zcash and TRON assets are added to the exchange's loss accounting.
